verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly ships its own automations that run without a human. Guarded rollouts raise traffic on their own while watching metrics for regressions, progressive rollouts release features in increments, and scheduled flag changes apply targeting changes at future points in time. These automations are limited to flag and release workflows, and scheduled changes are one-off future actions rather than recurring schedules. missing for 10: general-purpose or user-defined background automations beyond flag changes, recurring schedules, detailed docs on adaptive triggers, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions
